spans.s: प्रति—लक्षण n. ‘a counter-mark’, mark, sign, MBh.; R.
प्रति—लिङ्गम् ind. at every Liṅga, Rājat.
प्रति—लिपि f. a copy, transcript, written reply, L.
प्रति—लोक m. every world, Hcat.
disarranged, spoiled, MBh.
प्रति—लोम॑ mf(आ)n. against the hair or grain (opp. to अनु-ल्˚), contrary to the natural course or order, reverse, inverted
adverse, hostile, disagreeable, unpleasant
low, vile, ŚBr.; RPrāt.; ŚrS. &c.
left, not right, W.
contrary to caste (where the mother is of a higher caste than the father), ib.
प्रति—लोम॑ m. N. of a man
प्रति—लोम॑ m. pl. his descendants g. उपकादि
प्रति—लोम॑ n. any disagreeable or injurious act
see under प्रति, p. 663, col. 1.
प्रति—लोमा (आ), f. a partic. incantation (to be recited from the end to the beginning), Kathās.
प्रति—लोम॑म् (ibc. and अ॑म् ind.) against the hair, ag˚ the grain, in reversed or inverted order, TS.; Br.; ĀśvŚr. &c.
प्रति—लोमेन (एन), ind. in an unfriendly manner, unpleasantly, Cāṇ.

प्रति—लोम—ज mfn. born in the inverse order of the classes (as of a Kṣatriya father and Brāhmaṇī mother, or of a Vaiśya f˚ and Kṣatriyā m˚ or B˚ m˚, in which cases the wife is of a higher caste than the husband; cf. Mn. x, 16), W.
प्रति—लोम—तस् ind. in consequence of the inverted order or course, Mn. x, 68
invertedly, in inverted order or series, Yājñ.; MBh.; Pañcat.
प्रति—लोम—रूप mfn. inverted, KauṣUp.
प्रति—लो˚मानुलोम mfn. speaking against or for anything
(ibc. and अम् ind.) in inverted order or course and in the natural o˚ or c˚, Mn.; Yājñ.
प्रति—लो˚मानुलोमम् ind., in inverted order or course and in the natural o˚ or c˚, Mn.; Yājñ.
प्रति—लो˚मानुलोम-तस् ind. in an unfriendly and friendly manner, R.
प्रति—लोमक mfn. against the hair or grain, reverse, inverted, BhP.
प्रति—लोमक n. inverted order, perversion, Pañcat.
प्र-√ तिल् P. -तिलति, to be desirous of sexual intercourse, VS. (= स्निह्यति, Mahīdh.)

प्रति-√ लङ्घ् Caus. -लङ्घयति, to mount, sit down upon (acc.), Sarvad.;
to transgress, violate, MBh.
प्रति-˚लभ्य mfn. to be received or obtained, obtainable, BhP.
प्रति-˚लम्भ m. receiving, obtaining, finding, getting, Nir.; Kāv.
recovering, regaining (ifc.), Kād.
conceiving, understanding, Sarvad.
censure, abuse, W.
प्रति-˚लम्भित n. (fr. Caus.) obtaining, getting, MW.
censure, reviling, ib.
प्रति-˚लाभ m. recovering, receiving, obtaining, Śaṃk.
प्रति-√ लम्ब् (only ind.p. -लम्ब्य) to hang up, suspend, Pañcat. i, 453/454 (v.l.)

प्रति-√ लिख् P. -लिखति, to write back, answer by letter, Mālav.;
to wipe off, cleanse, purify, HPariś.
प्रति-˚लिखित mfn. written back, answered, Mālav.
प्रति-˚लेखन, n. or प्रति-लेखना, f. the regular cleaning of all implements or objects for daily use, HPariś.
प्रति-˚लेखन, n. or प्रति-लेखना, f. the regular cleaning of all implements or objects for daily use, HPariś.
प्रति-√ लिह् Caus. -लेहयति, to cause to lick at (2 acc.), ŚBr. (cf. प्रति-√ रिह्).
प्रति-√ ली Pass. -लीयते, to disappear, BhP.
प्रति-˚लीन mfn. unmoved or retired, ŚāṅkhGṛ.

प्रति-√ लुभ् Caus. -लोभयति, to illude, infatuate, RV.;
to attract, allure, MBh.
प्राति—लम्भिक mfn. (fr. लम्भ) ready to receive, expecting, L.
प्राति—लोमिक mf(ई)n. (fr. -लोमम्) against the hair or grain, adverse, disagreeable, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 28.
प्राति—लोम्य n. (fr. -लोम) contrary direction, inverse order, Nir.; Mn. &c.
opposition, MBh.; Rājat. (अ-प्रातिल्˚).
